# Tirupati Jewelles

> Premium Gold & Silver Jewellery Store in Bettiah, Bihar, India

Tirupati Jewelles is a trusted fine jewellery store located in Meena Bazaar, Bettiah, West Champaran, Bihar, India. Owned by Honey Soni, the store specialises in high-quality gold and silver jewellery for weddings, engagements, festivals, and everyday wear.

## Products & Services

- Gold jewellery (necklaces, earrings, bangles, rings, chains, pendants)
- Silver jewellery (payal, anklets, rings, idols)
- Bridal & wedding jewellery sets
- Engagement jewellery
- Festival & daily wear jewellery
- Custom jewellery design
- BIS hallmark certified gold jewellery
